selection: Standalone native compilation of the original 159 archive and const-member diagnostic cohort files.
method: Each source was compiled on its resolved Gradle classpath with all original source-owned class files and Kotlin package parts excluded. The successful compiles have class ownership receipts, SHA-256 of emitted bytes and inline relocation provenance where needed. Counts here measure compilation only. The initial 900-second VerseItem.kt attempt timed out. Retrying that same input on the same compiler with a 3,600-second limit produced 16 verified classes. Both receipts are retained. The summary includes the retry.
